column1: # THE STOCK-BOND CORRELATION's record bands (2026-10-14, item 61): the ten-year leg's monthly
# correlation with the equity market and how it moves with the inflation the market had seen, and
# the price level's noise by that inflation, three graded rows in two groups, each resampled in
# FIVE-YEAR blocks of months with its own joint band at its share of the mode's rows (`-of 3`,
# alpha 0.10). Both records public-domain: FRED's DGS10 read as a ten-year par bond rebought every
# observation, Ken French's daily market (Mkt-RF + RF), CPI-U (CPIAUCSL).
# THE ROWS FOLLOW THE SET'S RATE WINDOW: the S&P set's on 1962-2026 (DGS10 from 1962, CPI-U from
# 1954), the Nasdaq set's on 1999-2026. The record's correlation is +0.26 over 1962-1999, -0.30 over
# 2000-2020 and +0.50 since 2021: it rises with the inflation regime, +0.23 in the months above the
# 1962-2026 median rate and -0.11 below it, and a world whose ten-year yield the equity's discount
# never sees reads no dependence at all whatever its dials (the 0.25.0 recipes: slope 0.00 on both
# sets, the record at the 100th percentile of their histories).
#   STOCK-BOND (`stock_bond_readings`, the DGS10 par bond and the market over 21-session months of
#     the sessions both trade, 1962-01-04..2026-08-03 / 1999-01-05..2026-08-03; each month placed by
#     CPI-U's year-over-year rate of the calendar month before its first session, or the last
#     published month before that):
#     stock-bond corr monthly  the correlation of the two monthly log returns over the window
#     stock-bond corr slope on inflation seen  the slope of the two standardised returns' product on
#                             the rate seen, correlation per percentage point: 0.078 on 1962-2026
#                             (zero outside its band), 0.126 on 1999-2026. A split at the window's
#                             median rate reads the same dependence on the long window (0.34) and
#                             loses it on the short one, whose median sits inside one era; the slope
#                             holds on both and on either month convention
#     reported, not graded: the rolling 36-month correlation's sd (0.357 / 0.305) and its share of
#     windows below zero (37.5% / 85.3%)
#   CPI NEWS (`cpi_news_reading`, CPI-U 1954-01..2026-08 / 1999-01..2026-08, monthly log changes):
#     cpi news by inflation seen  the sd of the month-to-month change over the months whose
#                             year-over-year rate ending the month before is at or above the
#                             window's median, over the sd below it: 1.69 / 1.46. The level's noise
#                             scales with the inflation it carries, and with it the inflation news a
#                             regime brings to the yield; a world of one noise reads 1.0
# Each row carries the record's reading and its spread over 20,000 moving block resamples. FRED's
# series and the French market are public; the files are not shipped.
# Generated by `rust/src/bin/record_bands.rs -stockbond` (twin: `jsrc/recordBands.sc -stockbond`,

#       -cpi CPIAUCSL.csv -set sp500|nasdaq -from 1962-01-02|1999-01-01 -to 2026-08-03
